summary: Add a 'gd-tools install-hooks' command that wires gd-tools into the pre-commit framework: generate .pre-commit-hooks.yaml, write/merge a repos:local entry into .pre-commit-config.yaml (merge-by-id, never clobber foreign hooks), offer format/lint/test hooks with interactive prompt plus --all/--hooks/--non-interactive flags, and document the integration in README and USER_GUIDE.
